coordinates: Full-frame pixel coordinates: origin top left, x right, y down. Decoded 640x1080 crop at x640,y0, no resize; tracker added x640. All y values already full-frame.
method: Native Vision face landmarks; eye centroid midpoint, inter-eye distance and eye-line roll; native face observation rectangle. Optional [1,2,1]/4 temporal smoothing of midpoint y only, not source pixels.
limits: 2D translation damping does not remove pitch, eyelid changes, jaw articulation or camera-perspective scale changes.
Eye contour centroids can move slightly with blinks; use small smoothing and preserve natural residual.
Face bounding box is detector geometry, not a person/skin matte. Do not use its rectangle as a hard compositing seam.
No source media, narration or frame timestamps were altered.
